statements.status_notes: Upstream fixed CVE-2026-128241 (xmlwf -d output mode opened files with fopen, following a symlink planted at the output name) in libexpat PR #1502, commits 7e52b22 and 26f00fc (https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1502), which open the output file with O_NOFOLLOW, create it with mode 0600 and wrap the descriptor with fdopen. No Expat release carries it yet and Debian lists it as unfixed (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-128241). DHI backported both commits to its Debian 13 expat 2.9.0-1~deb13u1 packages: in the range's fixed version, on amd64 and arm64, /usr/bin/xmlwf in the expat package imports fdopen and no longer imports fopen, while the earlier 2.8.2, 2.8.3 and 2.9.0 builds still import fopen; those builds and the older builds of upstream 2.7.1, which predate the upstream fix, stay on the affected side of the range.
